long_biography.plain_text:
SANKO Holding grew from the Konukoğlu family's Gaziantep textile business into a diversified industrial group spanning energy, construction materials, packaging, machinery, healthcare and education. Simin Konukoğlu entered that family through her marriage to Zeki Konukoğlu, who led the group and now serves as honorary president.

Konukoğlu has maintained a low public profile while participating in family investment structures. She appears as a related party to the family's securities business and as one of five equal owners of Baltija Agrar alongside Zeki and their children. Her public appearances have centred on family and business occasions, without a documented management or board position within SANKO itself.
